model: Expected sale is gem rate × PSA 10 + (1 − gem rate) × PSA 9, after the sell fee. Cost is the raw card plus grading. Only 9s and 10s are modeled, the same way a clean-submission profit planner treats the downside. A listed gem rate is PSA 10s divided by that card's PSA population. A prior is used only when population is not in the book, and it is labeled.
